description: Billing status + self-service payment for your company: credit-wallet balance, pay-per-use flag, license tier / annual commitment, per-action prices, purchasable plans, and any approved-but-unpaid plans. Pass `checkout_request_id` to get a hosted Stripe Checkout URL to COMPLETE an approved plan, `topup_amount` (EUR) to get one to TOP UP the wallet, or `request_plan` (starter|pay_per_use|pro|max|enterprise) to REQUEST a plan (files a request for super-admin approval — never grants). Use this to view or RESOLVE a 402 without leaving the connector.

checkout_request_id.description: Approved license_request_id to complete payment for (returns a hosted Checkout URL)

request_plan.description: Optional plan key to request (pro|max|…) — files a request for super-admin approval; does not grant or charge

topup_amount.description: Optional EUR amount to top up the credit wallet (returns a hosted Checkout URL)

name: get_billing
